title: Embedded
goal: The headless engine runs on an arm64 Linux board without JUCE and is controlled from a browser on the LAN.

humanGates.text: Provide a Raspberry Pi class board with an audio interface on the LAN.
humanGates.how: The maintainer sets it up and gives SSH access details for the final check.

features.title: siann-host-headless: ALSA/JACK devices, ALSA MIDI, LV2 via lilv
acceptance: No JUCE and no X11 in the headless build; ALSA device implements AudioDevice with the stop contract; LV2 through lilv implements PluginHost.

features.title: arm64 cross build in CI
acceptance: A Linux arm64 headless build and test job (native runner or emulation).

features.title: LAN mode: TLS, pairing and per-client scopes
acceptance: Explicit opt-in; the engine serves the UI over https so the self-signed certificate is accepted once, or pairing installs a local CA; read-only, operate and approve scopes.

exit.text: The engine runs on a Raspberry Pi class board controlled from a browser.
